question: What is the annual average number of sets that were released between 1/1/2012 to 12/31/2015? Indicate the common langugage of the card.
evidence: AVG(id); releaseDate BETWEEN 1/1/2012 AND 12/31/2015; the common language refers to MAX(COUNT(language))
gold_sql: SELECT (CAST(SUM(T1.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.id)) / 4, T2.language FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' GROUP BY T1.releaseDate ORDER BY COUNT(T2.language) DESC LIMIT 1

fail_candidates.candidate_sql:
SELECT AVG(yearly_counts.sets_count) AS average_sets_per_year,
       (SELECT language 
        FROM set_translations st 
        JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code 
        WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
        GROUP BY language 
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
        LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM (
    SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', releaseDate) AS year, 
           COUNT(*) AS sets_count
    FROM sets 
    WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', releaseDate)
) AS yearly_counts;

SELECT 
    AVG(yearly_count) AS annual_average_sets,
    (SELECT language 
     FROM set_translations st 
     JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code 
     WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY language 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', releaseDate) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS yearly_count
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', releaseDate)
) yearly_stats

SELECT CAST(COUNT(s.id) AS FLOAT) / 4.0 AS annual_average, 
       (SELECT language 
        FROM set_translations st 
        JOIN sets s2 ON s2.code = st.setCode 
        WHERE s2.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' 
        GROUP BY language 
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
        LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM sets s
WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(s.id) AS FLOAT) / 4 AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT st.language 
     FROM sets s
     JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
     WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY st.language
     ORDER BY COUNT(st.language) DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM sets s
WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT 
    AVG(set_count) AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT language 
     FROM set_translations st 
     JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code 
     WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY language 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS year,
        COUNT(id) AS set_count
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', releaseDate)
) yearly_counts;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y', releaseDate))) AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT language 
     FROM set_translations 
     GROUP BY language 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM sets 
WHERE releaseDate >= '2012-01-01' AND releaseDate <= '2015-12-31'

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS year,
        COUNT(id) AS yearly_count
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', releaseDate)
),
common_lang AS (
    SELECT language
    FROM set_translations st
    JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY language
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    AVG(yearly_count) AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT language FROM common_lang) AS common_language
FROM yearly_counts;

SELECT T.language FROM (
    SELECT ST.language, COUNT(S.id) AS lang_count
    FROM sets S
    INNER JOIN set_translations ST ON S.code = ST.setCode
    WHERE S.releaseDate >= '2012-01-01' AND S.releaseDate <= '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY ST.language
    ORDER BY lang_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS T

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / 4 AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT T2.language 
     FROM sets AS T1 
     INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
     WHERE T1.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY T2.language 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM sets AS T1 
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / 4.0 AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT T2.language 
     FROM sets AS T1 
     INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
     WHERE T1.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY T2.language 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM sets 
WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT STRFTIME('%Y', s.releaseDate)) AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT st.language 
     FROM sets s2 
     JOIN set_translations st ON s2.code = st.setCode 
     WHERE s2.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY st.language 
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language
FROM sets s
WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
